falsification_criteria: No physical PASS without independently detected source departure and nonzero time separation
No physical PASS unless late window >100 qualified receiver clock cycles with eta_floor statistically positive and greater than error budget
Fail on nonconvergent spatial/temporal/core/box scaling, diverging energy, or unresolved flux
No promotion of a knot label without source hash and independent knot verification
Never infer photon absorption or full ring topology dissolution from local energy transfer
Numerical energy drift is reported as signed per-iteration truncation error, separated from physical moving-volume energy flux. CPU/GPU software parity alone cannot certify long-time capture.
null_hypothesis: H0: no independent qualification of source departure, positive late minimum energy above no-donor control across many cycles and convergent energy-flux closure.
objective: Adversarial falsification: 3D periodic Euler screening with separate controls for conservative energy, pressure, comoving control volume, explicit 0_1/3_1/5_2/6_1 embeddings, and strong non-promotion of short run proxies.

Check periodic box, core profile, source exit by material transport, and independent clock qualification
Execute independent held-out initial conditions and source-qualified knot geometries after locked gates
Run optional three-level periodic-box sensitivity with fixed physical dx and core width, record G10 diagnostic without asserting open boundaries

Compare translation-invariant vorticity spectral magnitude, energy and enstrophy at fixed absolute time; never infer topological conservation from Euler field
